abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.description: Wide melee swing. Range 2 — ignores cover.

abilities.name: Bullrush
abilities.description: Charge in a straight line, then slam down where you stop: the first enemy hit and every enemy within 2 squares of the landing take 14 and are knocked back 1 square, losing their Move.

abilities.name: Blood Frenzy
abilities.description: Heal 20 and gain Might for a turn. Sustain through aggression — the heal comes with a threat attached.

abilities.name: Shockwave
abilities.description: Stomp: all enemies within 2 squares take 12 and are Slowed. Disruption when surrounded.

ultimate.name: Seismic Rupture
ultimate.description: Shatter the ground: all enemies within 3 squares take 38 and are Rooted. Stand in the middle of them and detonate. (100 energy)
